Traceability and credit stay in X3: Lots, recalls, allergen records, credit limits and invoices are kept in X3, your system of record. We hold the order guide for each account and its prices, which your team edits in our admin tool. We also keep the orders kitchens send through the app.

Phone and portal accounts carry on: Restaurants that phone your desk, or order through a portal a partner built for your X3, carry on as before. Our app is for kitchens that would rather speak than type. A call your desk still takes is entered the way it is today, with no order number from us.

Your partner's plans go ahead as scheduled: Sage X3 upgrades and anything your partner is building go ahead on their own schedule. We install nothing in X3, and an order emailed to you needs no change there at all.

@graph.name: Is VoiceOrder Solutions a Sage X3 alternative?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. X3 keeps your customer accounts, lots, billing and stock, exactly as your partner configured it. VoiceOrder Solutions adds the kitchen's end: chefs say their orders into an app and fix any wrong line before it is sent.

@graph.name: Is it better than Sage X3?

acceptedAnswer.text: Only at one job: giving kitchens their own way to get an order to you, a job X3's own tools leave to your reps and phone staff. Once the order is in, X3 is the system you keep.

@graph.name: Can customers order through Sage X3 without calling us?

acceptedAnswer.text: Sage's own X3 pages list no customer portal among its features. They point to the Sage marketplace instead, where partners offer portals and online stores. Those let kitchen staff search and reorder by typing. Ours suits chefs who find talking quicker than typing, with each line checked before it goes.

@graph.name: Does anyone sell voice tools for X3?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. At least one company sells voice for X3, built for your own team to create orders and look things up by talking. Ours sits on the customer's side: the kitchen talks the order through in our app and corrects any line before it goes to you.

@graph.name: Does Sage X3 link to VoiceOrder Solutions?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. There is no ready-made link between the two, and Sage's support and ours each cover only their own software. If your X3 setup accepts EDI or API orders, they arrive without anyone typing them again; a demo will show whether yours does. By email, each order comes as a PDF, Excel or Word file whose lines were checked in the kitchen, and your staff type it in from that file instead of from a call or a voicemail.

@graph.name: Does our Sage partner need to be involved?

acceptedAnswer.text: Not to get started. Setting up needs no X3 login and installs nothing: we work from a spreadsheet you export. If you later want orders to arrive by EDI or through the API, the demo covers what that would need on your side, which may mean a word with your partner.

@graph.name: How quickly can we start, and what does it cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: Most distributors go live within 24 to 48 hours, because no work happens inside X3. Neither side publishes prices: X3 comes quoted through a Sage partner, and we quote per distributor. A Sage X3 replacement is a different scale of decision: it moves traceability, finance and the warehouse at once, often with a new implementation partner. That is the kind of Sage X3 alternative we do not sell.

@graph.name: Where do the Sage X3 details on this page come from?
